name: talk-loop — SKILL.md
title_zh: 跟着话题热度走，不抢话也不冷场的对话陪练
tagline_zh: 聊天总在尬聊或抢话？四条具体规则帮你盯住对方真正在意的点，还有自说自话的dogfood模式让你先练手。
tagline_en: Tired of awkward or dominating chats? 4 concrete rules track what truly matters to them, plus a self-talk dogfood.
desc_en: Evidence-driven conversation skill: 4 concrete rules for following the heat, plus a talking-head dogfood mode. Owner-approved iteration, no silent self-rewrite.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的'多倾听'，而是把'跟随热度'拆成四条可执行规则，且每次迭代都需你点头，绝不静默自我改写。
why_en: Not vague 'listen more'—breaks 'follow the heat' into 4 executable rules. Every iteration needs your approval; no silent.
limit_zh: 只适用于一对一对话场景，且需要对方持续输出可观察的言语信号；若对方沉默或只回单字，规则会失效。产物是对话策略建议。
limit_en: Only for 1-on-1 talks where the other party keeps producing observable verbal cues; silence or one-word replies break it. Outputs strategy tips, not.
title_en: Conversation coach that follows the heat, never hijacks
